description: Pause an HL perp copy trade (isActive=false) WITHOUT deleting it. Reads the current state first and is a no-op if already paused. While paused the copier mirrors neither opens nor closes, so copied positions stay open and will NOT follow the trader's exits; their TP/SL orders stay in place. Errors: PAUSE_STATE_UNVERIFIED (nothing sent), PAUSE_UNSUPPORTED (stored config invalid; explains the alternative), COPY_TRADE_NOT_FOUND.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

name: pause_hl_copy_trade
